review_text: It is a good game with nice graphics. I play it very rare but even then I manage to build or research something. I am not in a hurry so the pace is excellent for me. Moreover, if your plan is long term, then your strategy should be based on losing more resources to get a better protection. I am like an Orc with high attack and mediocre defense but it is working incredibly well. So far, I like the game, no spending was necessary.

I have been playing this game for the last 7 years off and on and I LOVE IT! I have had to start over several times due to changing phones and not saving my progress but I have starting over down pat. Adding on to My Comments (2/27/24) I am enjoying the new characters and playing fields. I'm piggybacking with the game dropping and disconnecting more from the server. Other than that I have no complaints.

One of the best mobile strategy games, as it has no ads whatsoever, and it's is completely free. Playing free does take a little longer, like in all games, but your still able to catch up. Spending money saves time rather than gaining an advantage. That's aside, there are only a few things worth spending money on. Also, I personally think that they should lower the time it takes to upgrade stuff, or make the upgrades better. I mean, 4 hours for +.3 gems per day? Absurd. Besides that, its golden!

Everything's good. However, I'm not able to track the member contributing to clan Capital. Also, the devs should allow lead and co-lead to modify the rules for new members that join or a board of rules to help members know the promotion, war, and clan capital rules. The priority upgrade in clan capital should also restrict other members from contributing to other buildings to better organize the upgrade. Same for clan wars which allow leader and coleader to customize the base to which mmbr attak

The game is well-designed, featuring impressive graphics and captivating content. It's highly motivating for players and stands out from many modern games that prioritize a 'pay-to-win' approach. While you have the option to make purchases for quicker progression, the game doesn’t pressure you to spend money. You can still enjoy the full experience without paying, though it may take a little longer. The monthly seasons keep the gameplay fresh, providing new experiences on a regular basis.

Overall, the game is more than fine. Good graphics and free-to-play and if you're willing to pay a little, you can get ahead a bit againts other players but not game breaking. I came back from playing a few years back and I think it's still good versus other games out there. Though the design of the later buildings and endgame units are a bit weird for my taste. Anyway goodjob supercell. TY

It's a brilliant game. Absolutely great. Easy to understand, easy to get into. Only a couple of problems. Certain aspects of the game take an absolute age - e.g mid game feels very slow. Things jump from minutes to hours to days very quickly. Secondly, the Battle Pass is a brilliant, and used to be worth it. The price has increased from ~£4 to £7 (at time of writing) since I've been playing and there's been no actual change/increase in benefits that acxomadte for the increase in price.

This game is very good and fun, but it's slowly becoming Pay-To-Win. Though I give it five stars because you can still play it without spending any money, and it remained fun. There are no enemies who bought equipment, and then they beat you and there are no secret sections of the game you can only access by paying. Also, every action takes progressively more and more time to complete, encouraging you to spend money to speed it up.

I recently returned to playing this game, and although there are only a few active players now, I'm enjoying it. However, I'm facing an issue where my attacks get abruptly interrupted, even though my internet connection is stable and fast. When I re-login, the attack is either counted or already completed, leaving me frustrated. I hope they can fix this issue soon, as it's affecting my gameplay and I can't seem to have a decent attack without it getting disrupted.

Best game to dominate and defend bases! Honestly, this game has a ton of ways to do so, going from your basic barbarians to dragons and the mythic troops! Now, yes, it does take a lot of time to make such small progress, but my "lot of time" (2-3 days) got me up to town hall 5 already with almost 3 builders and I would never dislike the game unless they got rid of something with a ton of potential. I'd reccomend downloading 100% if you want to include yourself in wars, clans, and defense!

I've been playing clash of clans for years now and all I can say is Clash of Clans is an engaging strategy game where you build, defend, and attack with a variety of troops. It's really fun to play and really addictive especially when it comes to clan wars. You can play with your friends, family, etc. Now my issue is on the builder base. I find it really hard to gain some elixirs and coins because for building and upgrading which is annoying. Please make an easier way to gain elixirs and coins.

Well first off, i think the developers should add a system where you can attack your friends to see who is more stronger and to make it more fun. Anad of course you can only attack your friends if they are the same town hall level. Also when attacking your friends you wont gain any gold or elixir, because it is just for "fun". Secondly everything about the game is just fun. Lastly, it is a very relaxing game since i play the game to just pass the time. All in all a very great game.

Absolutely delightful strategy game with an engaging mix of base-building, resource management, and tactical combat. The frequent updates and events ensure the content stays fresh, guaranteeing hours of fun. Gameplay wise, there's plenty to enjoy, whether you're going solo or teaming up with clan mates to tackle bigger challenges. While it does offer in-app purchases, with a bit of patience, the game remains rewarding and fun without spending a dime. A definite 5-star mobile gaming experience!

As a clan leader, I am very disappointed to see that clan war replays are no longer available through the entirety of the war details being visible. With the newest update, you can only watch war replays from the past few hours? Come on, Supercell. You make billions, and you can't afford some extra server space to have replays available through one single war. I've been playing since 2014, and it just seems to become more and more of a pay to play game. My interest is declining.

Imagine having a blast, being able to play a simple game, with ease while turning most of your brain off. This is an example of a great game, and what Town Hall 2-7 feels like. However; considering that the game develops into a major strategy game, it slowly gets less and less relaxing. This is a very well-developed game, but is hard to progress when most of the time, you wait for an upgrade for 5 days. If you only have a single game downloaded, Clash of Clans is optimal.

The game is all right in general, but they mess things up with updates. I was enjoying builder base side of it but they changed it. It's now a massive boring grind and not worth bothering with. The weekend raids are alright and base game is what it is, a long grind and pay to win, elements of fun in there. Just don't expect a reply from customer services with any issues with payments, they won't get back to you. The game pass is expensive and not worth it. Gd game to play while taking a dump.

I love these game and as the latest version comes, i think, a lot of players find it more easy to upgrade 'cause of the cost and time reduction applied. I love all about this game except one thing...i hope they can increase the number of glowy ore given to the players by league because some players like me find it hard to obtain due to its low number.

The game went from super good for normal people to play to pay for winning in a sneaky way (like those sneaky goblins) by releasing too many equipments to heroes to upgrade and only way to compete in top just by buying and gemming the upgrades. And upon those, silencing the voices of content creators (that's some big brain moves) having an opinion that doesn't align with the supercell. Anyhow, it's a good game,and many memories are associated with the game. It's sad to see going down in history

Absolutely smooth experience but over a long time, I just noticed one glitch in the game and it happens in clan games event. Whenever I start a mission in clan games, if I instantly start a battle after starting a mission, it doesn't register the progress. Then I have to do the same job again. That's the only thing I found as a bug or glitch. Thank you ❤️

(June 2021) Awesome game! Feels like it is falling into a pay to win hole. But as long as it stays away from that hole, it will stay one of my favourite mobile games of all time. (Feb 2024) UPDATE: It is most certainly falling down the pay to win hole. Very slowly, but its happening. Still one of the best mobile games out there, but there doesn't seem to be any high effort, non cashgrab games at the moment.

Certainly! "Clash of Clans" is a popular mobile strategy game where players build their own village, train troops, and attack other players' villages to earn resources and trophies. The game features a variety of units, buildings, and spells, allowing for strategic gameplay. With regular updates and a large player base, "Clash of Clans" continues to be one of the most successful mobile games, offering both casual and competitive gameplay experiences for players worldwide.

I used to have a 5 star review, but now this bug has been killing our clan for a month straight and has yet to be fixed. We used to have players always fill our clan, but out of nowhere, it suddenly stopped. Not a single person since then has joined. I think the Clan Notice just stopped working or something. I've even tried changing our clan settings, but still, nothing. Please fix this bug soon, others apparently have the same issue as me after doing some research.

Started playing years ago. Still do but this game is slowly killing itself. The "pay to win" features are increasing every update. There's also more forgotten parts of the game that they just don't get rid of. ex: builder base can get maxed out in less than a year and then is just nothing. Clan base is newer and takes a little longer but just as forgettable when complete.

How all multiplayer games should be! Great game to pick up whenever, no rush to do things at a set time and if you're attacked, no issue. Your buildings rebuild themselves and you get to collect some lost bounty back. After last update, mid way through every single fight, I get the network symbol and shortly afterwards, connection lost. I have no idea why as everything else works fine so has to be this app. It's getting very annoying now.

I absolutely like this game. The graphics are unbelievable, the effects are cool, and all those events are really fun and thrilling to play. Updates are also massive, such as the removal of training time and upgrading time being lowered, Clash of Clans is back to the peak of the game. The only thing I want your developers to improve is the heroes upgrade. They are way too time-consuming and require a dedicated heart

Good game but I have terrible internet connection. It's either happens when I'm attacking, building, or doing nothing. But that's not the issue, the issue is when I lose connection during a battle because if I don't finish putting down all my spells or troops I can't get full value which can make me lose a 3 star. This also happens during clan wars too. I go into battle, disconnect, takes one of my five attacks, then my clan mates get mad at me. This gets so bad that in fact, it works BETTER >🏙

Clash of Clans has been my favorite game since childhood, and it still keeps me hooked. The gameplay, strategy, and regular updates make it worth playing even after so many years. However, I’ve noticed one issue — even after clearing the game’s cache, the storage space it takes up returns almost immediately. This can be frustrating for players with limited storage. Apart from that, it’s still my best game ever.

Great game! It has a very simple gameplay yet enormous strategies to use in the game making it fun and exciting to play. The updates are very much appreciated especially with the addition of the events and new townhall every few months or so. There are few bugs and lags on the server where I play for quite some time but not that bad, developers seem to fix it very quickly. I'll keep it 4 stars for future improvements.

The Game is super fun to play. No bugs, no issues, no ads, no forcing for purchases and can be enjoyed by everyone. But this can be improved a lot by adding new features, strategies and customisation. Though all the structures are well designed there must be more customisation. I request the Supercell team to add these features if they understand me, then it will be one of the best games to ever exist!

I love this game. The strategy and building your base are fulfilling, and there are so many strategies for fun attacks. I mean, I don't have to tell you it's a great game. My only complaint is the lack of different free items. It's been glowy ore every time and it's only 10. Ore in general needs work, especially the glowy and starry. Edit* adding new equipment that's good. I spend time and money on making it better just for you to nerf it is extremely aggravating and unfair. STOP DOING THAT.

I love this game, but I am growing to resent the team. You are running this company like fame-hungry toddlers. Multi millions of dollars and you can't even get programmers that have any idea what they are doing or proper playtesting to ensure the player base (the people that pay for you to live the nice lives you live) can actually play the game and enjoy it without game breaking or disheartening outcomes due to glitch after glitch after glitch. I am insanely happy to hear that you will not be adding any loot based chest into the game. Hearing this in Judo Sloth Talks, knowing the game will never be a pay to win game or get a chance based rewards with money. That is more than enough to make me love the game more.

Whats with the revenge. You only get the same amount of loot that the other person looted from you. Its totally BS. No wonder people never plays this now. The time reduction and zero training time are amazing updates but this is like the game was going up and suddenly take a bad turn.

This is my third account this game is so AWESOME!!!! Did not think this game could get any better than it did!!! Love tue new version. Tye ship was great idea. Things could always be better ( like making the giants turn and fight when they are being attacked by hero or troops from clan castle ) just a thought! This game is worth the time and never gets old. Always something to look forward too completing. If you have not tried, what are you waiting for. LOVE THIS GAME! CLASH FOREVER!!!!

I started the game recently again, after a 1 star review I left last time I'm surprised to say, the game feels fresh and more fun to play, might be the time events? Definitely not the second village that's worst than old clash of clans but idk how to explain it, maybe the new rank system? I'm having so much fun playing the game nowadays.

"Fair" leagues is an absolute lie, you play all the time vs 1 townhall above you atleast, th9 must face th10 bases with inferno towers and the th10 uses sieges. for example, so you wasting your time trying to play fair as this game is NOT fair unless you the townhall above but then they place you vs townhalls above that one too. so LEAGUE is useless for this game.

Absolutely love this game and I'm hooked! Here's some things i would love to see in the game though..Could you make it more interactive like with clash royale where you could leave messages to compliment bases when you lose etc. Could you do more themes like with valentines day or daily rewards? Where you can get boosts etc. Can you play against your own base and see how you fair against yourself to test it? And also let there be more challenges in the main world. Save drafts when wifi lags.

I love the game but it would be great if you can donate elixir, dark elixir and gold to your clanmates and friends for when you have too much and they are struggling. It would just make it alot better and you'll be able to help your friends. It would also be cool if you could help your friends finish research or buildings faster.
The game has been improving every update. The dev team is doing a great job. It's still not perfect. I think some things in the game can still be improved.
great game, horrendous support. Can't access my village, have literal matvhing IDs, achievements, drvicr history, name, everything
This used to be a fun game, but Super Cell has embraced vibe coded AI slop and the game is now full of bugs and new features that don't work. So instead of fun, you're now constantly annoyed.

Clash of Clans is an amazing strategy game that still stands at the top of its genre. It offers a perfect mix of base building, attacking strategies, and teamwork through clans. Regular updates and new events keep the game fresh and exciting. The graphics are simple yet appealing, and the gameplay is smooth. Features like Clan Wars and Clan Capital make teamwork even more fun and engaging. The best part is that even as a free-to-play game, you can still progress with skill and strategy.

Really interesting game. Goofy characters interest the mechanic. It's like Boom Beach but with a main difference. I guess there were more bugs years ago. But as of now, I'll rate it 4 stars. Because no matter how good the base is. Someone at some point always manages to break into the base, which is very pointless, but you do the same as the others.

ranked mode needs to be fixed, I lost connection originally on my 5th ranked attack & obviously ended losing that one, then the 6th attack started with me losing because the game was out of sync somehow, & I can't even redo my own ranked attacks since this happened!

I love clash but there is a serious issue where it will kick me out and say please reload game due to network issues. There is nothing wrong with my network, and it's very frustrating when you're trying to go to attack and war and it just tells you to reload so you don't get your attack off... help me fix that and I'll give you a five stars. update 5-17-26: it's getting worse and it crashes on launch this is a newer phone but I'm not having any issue on my PC playing it...

Honestly brilliant game, good thing to pass the time. Management is fun, upgrading is satisfying, and it's f2p friendly. I'd rate it 5 stars if it weren't for builder base. It adds almost nothing to the actual game besides gear ups and an extra builder, and managing it and attacking feels more like a chore than fun. I recommend you add more features to make it more involved with the clan and main base, something to make it feel like a part of the game as opposed to a separate extra useless thing

The new league system should be separate from star bonus perks. Bring back the old trophy system. Supercell also needs a better management system for obstacles! There's no justifiable reason why obstacles should stop spawning based on how many obstacles are in the stash. It's such a hidden mechanic that's not disclosed.

Everything in this game is good just one thing cant we use our hero while we upgrade them. Like you can make them look they are training and once we took them battle during the training time just cut the time we use them, man it will really really help us enjoy the game more

I was having a perfect run on the ranked attacks and suddenly the app restarted, due internet connectivity problems. it didn't even let me join the last attack. I hated this new trophy mechanism, but this is absolutely unacceptable. fix the damn server or atleast bother to give the option to join the active attacks to players. Don't implement new system if you don't know how to handle it.

The game is overall great but I still do not understand why the battles end when the player loses connection to the game. I know that the battles are pre-determined as the players take action deploying troops, spells and siege machines, but it is illogical to immediately end a battle even though there is time left for the player to commence the attack, while they are disconnected. I believe this is the sole issue I have found in the game.

Good solid classic city building war strategic game. Unlike other games in the same genre, it's easier to comeback to and the game isn't pushing you to be hyper competitive just to survive. You can play at your own pace as casual player and you won't lose everything you've worked for. Edit: They thankfully fixed the journey rewards, since I finally got Royal Champion chest that's bugging just because I wasn't online when I reached it.👍❤️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Best Game Ever! Clash of Clans is honestly one of the most addictive and strategic games I’ve ever played. The graphics are smooth, the gameplay is super engaging, and there’s always something new to do—whether it’s upgrading your village, attacking enemies, or joining clan wars. The best part is the teamwork. Playing with clan members, planning attacks, and winning wars together feels amazing. The game also keeps getting updates, so it never feels boring. Controls are simple
They added too many stuffs into the game. As an older player who returned I feel overwhelmed.

Clash of Clans is a really fun and well-made game. It’s focused on grinding and taking your time, which is actually the whole point of it. The game is entertaining, time-consuming, and enjoyable without feeling unfair. It’s also great for free-to-play players since you can progress without needing to spend money. The game does a good job of guiding you at the start instead of throwing you into confusing mechanics. Overall, it’s a solid, well-balanced game that has only gotten better over time.

My favorite game is clash of clans. I don't play any other game except clash of clans game. My Town hall - 15. All the updates that you are bringing in the game are very good but new and old things should be given. For example -Equipment, hero skin, all these things are available from the shop. And make the base a little bigger so that it can hold more things.

This is the best game I have ever played. There are many things to do in it, but it always feels like some thing is missing, which is that the game feels empty, and to fill in the emptyness, the develpers shall make the game a little like clasha-rama. where the base is not the only thing to interact with. And by that I mean to add some lore to the game. As i know that only one revive is not enough for a huge update, but still I hope for good, and also to know what's behind the welcoming forest.

Having multiple ore types to upgrade Hero Equipment is a major progression bottleneck. Each ore is difficult to earn and the rewards are often unpredictable, making upgrades feel slow and frustrating. It makes upgrades feel restrictive and pushes the game toward a pay-to-win model.
Slow loading and always crash or close app.

I had been playing it for almost 10 years...and this is my fav ever. But the real issues are the upgrade...they are too much lengthy and it would just shake your head. I really want Supercell to reduce the upgrades and limit to max 5Days...not more than that.I am giving it 5 stars because the whole gameplay amazing...it gives an addictive and attractive gameplay..and the best thing it wouldn't hamper your studies because it takes max. 10-15 mins to do everything you can do at once u open it.

Game has become too complex, so many bases and so many places to click. if blacksmith resources are full, what to do with them? capitol gold is full, no more upgrades. you should delete capitol and builder base and get something new now.

Well.... there is much to say about this game. I am really enjoying the game. Good troops, good mechanics, Bunch of clubs to join, also good upgrades. But there's one thing I bit dislike. except gold storage, gold mine, clan castle, and laboratory, all the other resources including walls require Coins for upgrade. For upgrades, Elixir is used very less times. Nothing much, overall the game good and enjoyable . 😊😁

FANTASTIC, it was like 2 yrs ago since I played and it is INCREDIBLE the U.I. has changes and it is great to see that training no longer needs time!! Ever since the recent updates, I constantly get the "Client and server are out of sync" pop-up. I have cleared my cache and checked the play store, but there are no new updates available. It incredibly frustrating to get kicked out in the middle of managing my base. Please fix your servers!

Absolutely love the game, have been playing it since launch. Recently tho the gameplay has been annoying, it's like if you don't play all the time then you won't get anywhere. I love the new attacking and ranking system, accept for if I don't do my ranked attacks, I get demoted and if I don't sign up, I also get demoted. Sometimes I just wanna play without having to worry if I have to attack or not. Everyting else is great, but that one feature makes it not be a 5 star for me.

Clash of Clans is one of the best strategy games I have ever played. The game offers a perfect mix of village building, resource management, and exciting battles. I really enjoy participating in Clan Wars and Clan Games with friends. The developers continue to add new content and improvements, which keeps the game fresh and interesting. The graphics are great, the matchmaking is fair, and there are many ways to progress even without spending money. Highly recommended to anyone who loves strategy

The experience lasts about 5-15 minutes because of attacks, but their purpose of the game is to upgrade and you can upgrade about 6 things at a time. by the time you unlock the 4 builder each building takes 1 to 3 days. I have never had the game crash. However, it does require internet or Wi-Fi, I do not know which. I always get the two mixed up. there are no advertisements. You can buy items in the game with real world currency, but it is only cosmetics and basic loot, like coins.

This game has action, lore, and all in between which is why I love playing this game so much! it's a game with basic rules that makes it easy to pick up and play which makes the experience even more enjoyable! You get to explore different worlds, while battling difficult enemy kingdoms in a click to drop style! In conclusion I'd recommend anyone and everyone to play Crash of Clans! Thank You for listening!

Super fun Game! Play it for years now and it never gets boring. But you could reduce the wall upgrade costs especially at higher townhalls. And a nice feature you could add is that you can leave messages or emotes when the battle is over (like in clash Royal). I very like it that there are so many events, gold pass and star bonus because this keeps the game fun to play. But random disconnecting issues are so frustrating. when you lose connection during a battle, even if it's just because your device is switching networks, which mind does even when I have "good signal" i cannot reconnect to my attack even though the game knows it's "still going" because I can't start another. when this hop ends during Clan war or a ranked attack, it's really frustrating and there's not anything you can do about it. please fix!

An amazing strategy game. Being at Town Hall 11 right now, it's very fun. Barb King and Minion Prince are tanky Heroes and good w/ Puppets equipment. Good pair for Town Hall 9 and 10. EDIT: Restarted the game for the new update. I can't do everything in it yet, but the Spring Trap rework is a lot better, and my current Town Hall 11 base is somewhat maxed. Summer Jam looks great this year! Stop hating the Puppets, summoning armies are OP if you know how to do them.

COC is still the best game by Supercell. It is so engaging even after so many years. Removing training time and healing for heroes, easier and more variety of attacks, reducing building costs and durations, everything has been great for the home base. The p2w equipment for heroes are good, but they're not compulsory. I hope they make the builder base a bit faster, too.

The game is fun and challenging: graphics, environment, warriors, and heroes are excellent. The game needs a strategy to destroy enemy bases. The training times have been removed, which is why attacking is more frequent now, but reducing upgrade times would reduce the time of waiting, and cheaper upgrade costs, especially spending with gems, could enhance the experience of every player. I hope this game will have an invitational challenge where you can search and invite any player in the game.

perfect game. on town hall 12 and so far I have no complaints. I do have a recommendation though. I wish there was a queue for upgrading stuff. it would start a new upgrade from the top of your requested list to the bottom. it wouldn't use resources until the upgrade actually starts so that way if you change your mind and want to switch you can. great game!

The game was good. First, when most new players are playing it at the first time, they will thought, it's just about attacking, building, and making clans. No, it's not about all that, because Clash of Clans offers a fun gameplay, here you can strategize, make planning. This game will further enhance your ability to strategize things before you attack, because this game is all about planning and knowing how to execute the plan. Overall, good game, good graphics, and not laggy. 5 stars.
